name: email-service
description: Submit one human notification intent and read its delivery status via the authenticated central email-service MCP.

tools.name: send_notification
tools.description: Accept one human_notification_intent for later delivery. The service resolves recipients by principal_id, sends from the configured public mailbox and returns accepted_for_delivery; success means the intent is queued, not that mail was delivered and never that any domain fact changed.
allowed: reporting execution and review state changes to a human
asking a human to act through their own harness

tools.name: get_notification_status
tools.description: Read delivery status for a notification the caller submitted. Ordinary callers only see their own notifications; the response carries delivery_status, attempt_count and a stable error_summary, never the body, credentials or raw sender output.
allowed: confirming whether a submitted notification was delivered

notes: recipient_resolver_unavailable is temporary: the service still runs an unbound recipient resolver, so notifications fail before persistence until a real Registry contact adapter is wired (tracked separately).
EMAIL_MCP_URL must point at the /mcp path of the email-service Streamable HTTP endpoint.
The bearer token maps to one caller_id per researcher, so delivery status stays scoped to that researcher's own notifications.
